# Arte da arena

As imagens foram criadas com a ferramenta integrada de geração de imagens.
Os PNGs originais gerados foram copiados para esta pasta; os atlas preservam a
transparência. O código usa quatro colunas por atlas, com duas linhas para tropas
e uma linha para locais. Movimentação, efeitos e mudanças de equipamento são
animados pela aplicação; os atlas contêm poses estáticas.

## battlefield.png

```text
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape background texture for a browser RTS game battlefield. Create a beautiful hand-painted fantasy strategy game map viewed strictly directly from above, flat overhead, landscape 3:2 composition. Moss green meadow with gently mottled grasses, tiny stones, subtle winding ochre dirt footpaths across the middle, soft warm afternoon light. Dark dense pine and oak forest border only along the very outer edges, scattered ruined ancient stone only at the border. Vast open unobstructed playable center covering 85 percent of canvas. Balanced symmetrical terrain left and right, slightly dark moody palette, rich painterly detail, polished indie strategy game visual. No characters, no armies, no buildings, no rivers or water, no mountains, no UI, no text, no logos, no grid. This will be a functional map with units overlaid; keep central visual noise low.
```

## troops.png

```text
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for browser fantasy RTS game. Exactly 8 isolated full-body character sprites arranged on a perfectly regular grid of 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Each cell identical size with sprite centered, all sprites same scale and feet aligned, ample padding so no sprite touches another cell. Transparent background, no shadows extending beyond cells. View three-quarter top-down RTS character view, stylized detailed painterly pixel art, crisp silhouette readable at 32 pixels. TOP ROW from left to right: blue-cloaked human worker unarmed, blue-cloaked human swordsman with sword and shield, blue-cloaked human spearman holding upright spear, blue-cloaked human axeman. BOTTOM ROW same four roles as dark armored evil construct soldiers with glowing orange eyes and crimson capes: unarmed dark worker, evil swordsman, evil spearman, evil axeman. Friendly side uses steel armor and ivory/turquoise details, evil side obsidian armor with orange/coral details. All face slightly to the right. Exactly 8 sprites in a 4 by 2 grid, no titles, no labels, no lettering, no UI, no extra characters or ground tiles.
```

## locations.png

```text
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent environmental sprite atlas for a fantasy browser RTS. Exactly 4 isolated game environment sprites in one horizontal row, four equal square cells, each object perfectly centered in its cell with ample padding and identical camera angle. Three-quarter overhead strategy game view, detailed painterly pixel art compatible with medieval RTS. Left to right: compact cluster of three rich green pine trees and logs representing a forest resource node; small rugged gray ore deposit with glowing blue crystal fragments representing a mine; compact medieval blacksmith armory building with tiled roof, stone walls, orange glowing forge and an anvil; small medieval hospital cottage with cream cloth canopy, herbs and an unmarked white medicine banner. Transparent background, soft small contained contact shadows only. Distinct silhouettes, polished indie game art, warm natural light, no UI, no writing, no labels, no logos, no borders. Exactly four objects in a regular 4-column by 1-row atlas.
```
